topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture on cancer therapy and outlines the session's core learning objectives.

topics.label: Conventional cancer treatments and cytotoxic drug resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional local and systemic cancer therapies along with the mechanisms underlying cytotoxic toxicity and cellular drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cellular vulnerabilities and checkpoint defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic cancer vulnerabilities, including hormone dependence, cell cycle checkpoint loss, and synthetic lethality.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the rationale and molecular mechanisms of targeted oncogenic kinase inhibition alongside the pathways through which tumors acquire resistance.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address targeted antibody modalities designed to recognize tumor surface markers and deliver cytotoxic payloads.

topics.label: Cancer immunology and immunotherapeutic strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the evidence for natural immune surveillance and the clinical application of checkpoint inhibitors and engineered T-cell therapies.

topics.label: Clinical challenges, historical progress, and future directions in cancer management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review overall progress and systemic challenges in cancer treatment, evaluating future therapeutic paradigms and clinical trial dilemmas.
